jobs.description:
**Why Mobility Global?**
At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people.
  
  
Join a team singularly focused on transforming the automotive industry. S&P Global Mobility is Mobility Global — the company behind CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Market Scan, and Polk Automotive Solutions. Our strength comes from our people, and here, the progress you make helps the entire automotive ecosystem move faster and with greater confidence.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the AI Engineering team at Mobility Global. We build the conversational analytics products, shared AI services, and agent platforms that sit on top of the industry’s deepest automotive dataset, and we build the internal tooling that drives AI adoption across the PDLC/SDLC, from requirements and design through code, testing, and release. We are a small, senior, product-minded team that owns its work end to end, from the React front end a customer touches through the FastAPI services and data layer behind it to the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether the answer was right.
  
  
We work AI-natively by default: coding agents, agentic workflows, and LLM-assisted review are part of how the team ships every day, not a side experiment, and we care as much about engineering judgement as we do about raw output. This role is a deliberate early-career seat on that team, with senior engineers close by and real production ownership from the first quarter.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Build LLM-powered features in Python — agentic workflows in LangGraph, retrieval and RAG pipelines, text-to-SQL, and tool/MCP integrations that reach real users rather than staying in a notebook.
* Ship the services behind them — write clean, typed, tested Python and FastAPI endpoints, including streaming responses, async I/O, and sensible error handling.
* Own evaluation and quality for what you build — assemble golden datasets, write eval and guardrail test suites, instrument traces, and use the results to decide whether a change actually helped.

**Job Summary**

**LLMs · Embeddings · Evaluation · Agentic Systems · Multi-Modal AI**

The Associate AI Engineer will build and evaluate LLM-powered features for FarmerChat, Digital Green's conversational AI platform serving millions of smallholder farmers. We are seeking an engineer with Python skills and hands-on LLM experience to design, test, and monitor AI systems that work reliably in multilingual, low-resource, and real-world agricultural contexts. You'll rotate across feature development, evaluation testing, and observability depending on sprint priorities—gaining broad exposure across the full AI stack.

In this role, you will write and refine prompts, build agentic workflows using tool-use patterns and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), maintain embedding and vector store pipelines, and work with multimodal data (text, speech, image) to serve farmer-facing advisory tools. You'll define and run automated evaluation frameworks to catch hallucination and bias before models ship to production, and collaborate with senior engineers, product, and field teams to ship reliable AI systems. This is a generalist role with genuine mentorship—your contributions matter from day one, and you'll grow rapidly in a fast-moving, impact-driven team.

* Help build features for FarmerChat using LLM provider APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write and refine prompts, call APIs, and wire up tool-use patterns using provider SDKs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

* Run and extend automated test suites that check LLM outputs for accuracy, hallucination, and bias using tools like Ragas, DeepEval, or Promptfoo.

**4. Monitor, Debug & Document**

**Qualification & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* Solid Python skills - comfortable writing code beyond notebooks.

* Familiarity with prompt engineering basics (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output).
* Basic understanding of embeddings and vector stores.
* Git and collaborative development workflows.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agentic workflows, MCP, or tool-use patterns.
* Hands-on with speech models (Whisper, Deepgram) or vision models (ViT, CLIP, YOLO).
* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo).
